profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Flint Hills Resources

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Design, deploy and test customized components for business applications using .NET technologies, data management systems, and service back-ends.
Support the daily operations of the business through technical analysis of a diverse set of business applications for both in-house and third-party solutions.

positions.title: Applications Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Worked with internal and external customers to test and install new application systems as well as upgraded existing platforms.
Worked with leads from other IT departments to provide solutions and to build relationships.
